purpose: Immutable idempotency receipt for self-scoped Movement Policy create, revise and retire operations.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self-Person scope for the operation.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Caller operation identity used for exact replay.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty text up to 200 characters.

columns.name: expected_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Expected current policy state for CAS when required.
columns.value_contract: Null on create; exact current state on revise/retire.

columns.name: resulting_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: New immutable policy state produced by create/revise.
columns.value_contract: UUIDv7 state for create/revise; null on retire.

columns.name: automatic_movement_code
columns.meaning: Accepted automatic-movement mode carried by create/revise intent.
columns.value_contract: blocked or automatic; null on retire.

columns.name: acceptance_path_code
columns.meaning: Accepted movement acceptance path carried by create/revise intent.
columns.value_contract: direct or confirmation_required; null on retire.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation
primary_key.reason: Operation ids are scoped to authenticated self-Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_self_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind replay control to the authenticated self-Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the receipt to the governed Schedule.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_expected_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain the exact CAS basis for revise/retire.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_resulting_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain the exact resulting immutable policy state.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_shape
check_constraints.expression_contract: create has no expected state and has resulting state/codes; revise has expected and resulting state/codes; retire has expected state and no resulting state/codes
check_constraints.reason: Keep each receipt semantically total for its mutation kind.

indexes.name: ux_schedule_movement_policy_mutation_operation_resulting_state
indexes.reason: A resulting policy state belongs to one accepted mutation receipt.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Receipt references accepted immutable policy states but is not itself policy truth.
state_history.current_binding: Does not select current state; it records the accepted operation basis/effect.
state_history.chronology: created_at records accepted operation time; replay returns the original effect.

lifecycle.retention: Retain for idempotent replay and auditability.

obligations: policy mutation remains independent from Schedule placement mutation
